name: spellkave_diff
label: Diff Manifests
description: Compare two manifest TOML files semantically: rows matched by natural/composite identity, line order ignored. only-left = gaps (in the reference, missing from the export); only-right = snapshot/play; changed = same key, field-level diffs. Offline. Default ignore list drops snapshot/enrichment noise (elevation_class, visibility, expires_at_tick, place_node_id on entities/locations, object_state.bundle_id, value_bool beside value_int/value_text). Repeatable --map-key from=to rewrites entity/actor key prefixes (and fields that carry them) before compare.

left.description: Reference manifest TOML (only-left rows are gaps).

right.description: Compared manifest TOML (only-right rows are snapshot/play).

ignore_fields.description: Comma-separated extra field names to ignore on every kind (merged with the default snapshot/enrichment list).

kinds.description: Comma-separated row kinds to compare (default: every array-valued kind).

only.description: Restrict the report: gaps = only-left, snapshot = only-right, changed = same key with field diffs.

map_key.description: Repeatable from=to key-prefix maps (sk-0m4.54). Rewrites entity/actor keys and every string field that is or embeds that key before compare, so an export keyed candidate_1 can match a reference keyed hero_1.

promptSnippet: Diff two manifest TOML files by row identity (order-insensitive)
promptGuidelines: spellkave_diff: pass two TOML paths; left is the reference (gaps), right is the export (snapshot/play).
spellkave_diff: a non-empty report is information, not failure — do not retry or treat it as invalid.
spellkave_diff: --map-key from=to (repeatable) rewrites entity/actor keys and reference fields before compare.

examples.description: compare a created candidate export to Renn without key-prefix noise
